summaryLine: One sentence for the patch header.

gods.name: God Name
gods.title: Optional card title (defaults to name)
gods.note_featuredImage: Key maps in lib/newGodPatchImages.js (Metro require). Splash under app/data/Patch Notes/New God Image/

skins.name: Skin Name
skins.note: Optional. image: skin path for getSkinImage, e.g. /icons/Wallpapers/Name.webp — or drop file under app/data/Icons/Wallpapers/

wanderingMarket.title: Classic Traveler: Example Skin
wanderingMarket.note: featuredImage key maps in lib/wanderingMarketImages.js (Metro require).

adjusted.name: God Name
adjusted.note: Optional — aspect note shows aspect icon on grid

note_shifted: Each highlights row is its own entry. Base + aspect split separately. SHIFTED = mixed buff + nerf lines on that same row (inferred from patch text). Separate aspect-buff + base-nerf rows stay in their own buckets. Items use the same rules.

note_bucket_taxonomy.buff: Stats added or values increased (damage, heal, protections, max mana pool, etc.). Cooldown/ability mana cost/item cost reduced = buff.
note_bucket_taxonomy.nerf: Stats removed or values decreased. Cooldown, ability mana cost, and item cost increased = nerf. Max mana pool decreased = nerf.
note_bucket_taxonomy.shifted: Mixed buff + nerf on one entry — playstyle or build-path change without a full rework.
note_bucket_taxonomy.adjusted: Numeric tweak (common balance change): tuning damage, CD, mana, protections. Reenabled/fixes. Auto-inferred reworks land here until a Rework grid exists.
note_bucket_taxonomy.rework: Major overhaul — abilities or systems redesigned. Tag manually in highlights if needed; parser detects rework/overhaul/redesign wording.

systems.title: Conquest
systems.note: Short chip label for Systems row
